name: Cleo Aripa
source:
"Kuu-chan has the strength of a thousand men!" 

 The third head of the Aripa family, who rule Touchou. She's extremely selfish, and constantly puts her servants in troublesome situations. She has a childish personality. 

 Battle quote - "What are you looking at! Just because Kuu-chan's of royal blood!"
[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
